verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a self-serve Sandbox workspace that needs no sales contact (docs-4). Sandbox behavior is simulated, for example Boletos are auto-paid within an hour (docs-5). It is isolated from production by separate base URLs and credentials, with SDKs selecting the environment (docs-6). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and documentation of simulation coverage beyond Boletos (e.g., Pix, transfers, cards, webhook triggering).
